data.subject: Local Ledger four-week pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in INBK and CBNA.

On September 10, 2026, INBK disclosed that it entered into a material definitive agreement in an 8-K Item 1.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1562463/000156246326000092/inbk-20260910.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
